title: Stencil Spray
description: Airbrushed playing-card suits. Each suit — heart, spade, club, diamond and a four-point sparkle — is rasterised into a signed distance field, and the spray is a function of that distance: densest right at the stencil edge and feathering outward, so the symbol reads as clean negative space punched out of a cloud of paint drifting over grainy paper. Because real distance fields drive it, two suits crossfade by lerping their fields, giving a smooth morph from one symbol into the next as the deck cycles. Halo width, spray grain, inside glow, core burn, spin, paint and paper colours are all live, and a beat can bloom the spray so the paint pulses to sound.
